SELECT SUM(player_total) AS sum_of_totals,
              AVG(player_total - average_total) AS average_excess
       FROM (
           SELECT player_id,
                  SUM(g_1b - g_cf) AS player_total,
                  death_country
           FROM appearances
           JOIN player USING (player_id)
           WHERE death_country IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(death_country) <> ''
             AND g_1b IS NOT NULL
             AND g_cf IS NOT NULL
           GROUP BY player_id, death_country
       )
       CROSS JOIN (
           SELECT AVG(player_total) AS average_total
           FROM (
               SELECT player_id,
                      SUM(g_1b - g_cf) AS player_total
               FROM appearances
               JOIN player USING (player_id)
               WHERE death_country IS NOT NULL
                 AND TRIM(death_country) <> ''
                 AND g_1b IS NOT NULL
                 AND g_cf IS NOT NULL
               GROUP BY player_id, death_country
           )
       )
       WHERE player_total > average_total
